summary: Ways to support the volunteer AAPS project: donating, writing code, editing the English documentation, translating the app or docs on Crowdin, and answering questions in the community. No app screens are involved.

sections.heading: AAPS operates entirely on volunteer efforts and has no paid staff.
sections.summary: Why donations help the volunteer developers (test hardware, shipping, meetings).

sections.heading: I can write code! How do I participate?
sections.summary: Developers: pick an issue, ask on Discord, open a first pull request.

sections.heading: I know the system and can write documentation!
sections.summary: Documentation writers: the Discord channel and the guide to editing the English docs.

sections.heading: I do speak multiple languages and want to translate the app or the documentation
sections.summary: Translators: start with the app strings, then the docs, both on Crowdin.

sections.heading: Are there other ways to help?
sections.summary: Other useful skills, such as design and answering questions in the community.
